🧭 MONTRÉAL BOROUGH MAZE

Carved from the real outline and real arrondissement (borough) boundaries of the City of Montréal. Crossing between boroughs is only possible at one or two real shared-border “doorways” per pair, so the actual city map shapes the path. Real landmarks are marked with red rings.

Solution

Montréal — Solution
How to play: Trace a single path from START to FINISH without crossing any walls. The bold line is the real city outline; thin dashed lines are real borough borders; thin solid lines are maze walls. The two blank gaps near the middle of the island are Mont-Royal Park and the Parc Jean-Drapeau islands (Île Sainte-Hélène / Île Notre-Dame) — both are city parkland administered outside the regular borough system, so they aren't part of any borough polygon in the source data and are shown as empty space rather than carved with a maze. Solution is at the end if you get stuck.
